product_overview: Ship Fast is an AI-powered website generator that turns a natural-language project description into a live website preview. Users can watch generation progress, refine the result in a dashboard, edit the preview inline, and export the finished site.
core_goals: Generate a website from a written project description
Monitor generation progress and view the generated preview
Refine generated content through chat and inline editing
Sign in to claim sessions and unlock premium actions
Export the generated site when eligible

features.name: Homepage Generation
features.description: Users create a new website generation session by describing what they want built on the homepage.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Type project description in prompt input field -> Select prompt language from dropdown -> Optionally add design reference URLs -> Submit prompt form to start generation -> See a new session dashboard
Navigate to / -> View public gallery of recent sessions
Navigate to / -> Submit prompt form with no remaining anonymous quota -> See authentication overlay

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Users sign in or create an account so they can claim sessions and access account-based features.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open sign-in experience from the top navigation -> Choose Google, GitHub, or email sign-in method -> Fill in email and password for email auth -> Complete sign-up flow for a new account -> Return signed in
Navigate to / -> Open sign-in experience from the top navigation -> Choose email sign-in method -> Fill in email and password -> Submit credentials -> Return signed in
Navigate to / -> Sign out from account menu -> Return to anonymous browsing

features.name: Session Dashboard
features.description: Users watch the live generation process, inspect progress logs, and interact with the generated site preview from the session dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /session/:id -> View generation task list and progress logs -> Watch preview iframe load the generated homepage -> Toggle desktop and mobile preview sizes -> Refresh preview after generation completes
Navigate to /session/:id -> Open debug panel with debug query param -> Inspect additional generation details

features.name: Preview Editor
features.description: Users make inline edits directly in the generated site preview and can restore earlier versions of their changes.
user_flows: Navigate to /preview/:sessionId -> Select elements in the preview -> Edit text, colors, spacing, and layout -> Save inline text and style changes
Navigate to /preview/:sessionId -> Select elements in the preview -> Edit content in the preview -> Restore previous edits from history

features.name: Chat Studio
features.description: Users refine the generated site through chat and update CMS-related settings from the session dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /session/:id -> Send chat messages to refine the generated site -> Review the updated result in the dashboard
Navigate to /session/:id -> Upload images for CMS content -> Edit CMS site settings -> Save the updated CMS configuration
Navigate to /session/:id -> Open Sanity studio embed -> Manage CMS content in the embedded studio

features.name: Export and Payments
features.description: Signed-in users can view export targets, start a checkout flow for premium features, and download the exported site when eligible.
user_flows: Navigate to /session/:id -> View export target options -> Open payment modal for premium features -> Start Stripe checkout
Navigate to /session/:id -> View export target options -> Open payment modal for premium features -> Start Razorpay checkout
Navigate to /session/:id -> View export target options -> Download exported zip file

known_limitations.issue: /terms page is linked in footer but has no Express route registered
known_limitations.impact: Terms link redirects to homepage instead of showing terms content

known_limitations.issue: Coupon validation API called from dashboard but no server handler exists
known_limitations.impact: Coupon field in payment modal may fail silently

known_limitations.issue: Anonymous sessions are limited to 2 generations per day
known_limitations.impact: Unauthenticated users hit quota and must sign in to continue
